name: itecs-halopsa
description: Read-only HaloPSA MCP connector for ITECS finance, billing, and operations workflows.

interface.longDescription: Provides a bundled read-only HaloPSA MCP server for ITECS finance, billing, purchase-order, client, invoice, recurring-invoice, and contract lookup workflows. Credentials and runtime configuration stay outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: List HaloPSA purchase orders that need CFO review.
Look up a HaloPSA client, invoice, contract, or PO.
Use HaloPSA read-only tools for billing evidence.
